code_hints: If initial navigation is redirected to the home page after consent, re-navigate to the PLP URL once modals are dismissed.
Treat modal clicks as optional: attempt selectors and continue without failing if not present.
Increase wait for PLP tiles to 12s due to heavy JS; only consider PLP ready when at least 8 tiles are present.
Auto-scroll to bottom to trigger lazy loading; if a Load More button appears, click it until it disappears or no new tiles are added.
Normalize locale on every discovered link using the url_rules to avoid drifting to en-jp/en-us locales.
On PDP price parsing, normalize European formats (e.g., replace non-breaking spaces, convert comma decimals) and preserve the € currency.
rationale: The failure likely stems from locale/cookie overlays and locale drift, causing no PLP tiles to render or redirecting to the home page. Prioritizing safe overrides: accept OneTrust cookies, confirm country/locale, enforce en-de via URL normalization, and extend PLP readiness by waiting for common Moncler product card selectors with auto-scroll. Selectors include robust fallbacks for both PLP tiles and PDP price/title without overfitting.
